note: Rio Arriba County (35039) publishes zoning only as ordinance text (Yellow Book PDF) and the county GIS page links only a parcel web viewer (raassessorco.maps.arcgis.com). No public queryable zoning district layer found for the county or its city Espanola. The county's ArcGIS Online items (services2.arcgis.com/WexOnM0vIyrVcdaI) cover flood zones, addresses and city boundaries, not zoning. The state OSE parcel layer (County_Parcels_2025 MapServer/21) carries ZoningCode fields but its service returns 'not started', and it is a parcel layer, not districts. Espanola's zoning map is referenced by the city but no service URL was found. Regrid and zoneomics are commercial/third-party and not usable.
